_note: Every number the simulation and the business case use. Illustrative assumptions for a fictional operator — not real company data. low/high are the range used in the sensitivity analysis. A test fails if the simulation stops reading one of these, or reads a key that is not listed here.

assumptions.label: Freight units booked per cancelled sailing
assumptions.why: Large freight RoRo on an overnight route, booked close to full before a storm.

assumptions.label: Share of units with a driver (accompanied)
assumptions.why: Overnight North Sea routes are mostly unaccompanied trailers.

assumptions.label: Share of units that are reefers
assumptions.why: Food and pharma flows to the UK.

assumptions.label: Share of reefers with a delivery deadline that matters (fresh produce, flowers)
assumptions.why: Frozen cargo can wait; fresh cargo has a market slot.

assumptions.label: Share of perishable reefers whose booking carries a usable commodity code and deadline
assumptions.why: Today the field is free text and optional; the TO-BE can only protect what the booking data says is perishable.

assumptions.label: Perishable deadline: earliest, hours after the original departure
assumptions.why: Next-morning market slot plus road leg.

assumptions.label: Perishable deadline: latest, hours after the original departure
assumptions.why: Shelf life of the slowest-spoiling fresh goods in the mix.

assumptions.label: Share of units with dangerous goods (ADR)
assumptions.why: Chemicals and gas cylinders; limited to weather-deck slots.

assumptions.label: Share of oversized / project cargo
assumptions.why: Only some vessels have the deck height.

assumptions.label: Customers with units on the cancelled sailings
assumptions.why: Mix of forwarders, hauliers and shippers.

assumptions.label: Contract customers (allotment holders) among them
assumptions.why: Large forwarders with yearly allotments.

assumptions.label: Share of units belonging to contract customers
assumptions.why: Allotments are the backbone of the route.

assumptions.label: Units without a customs pre-lodgement at cancellation
assumptions.why: UK import declaration not yet lodged; the unit cannot be loaded.

assumptions.label: Mean time until a missing customs pre-lodgement is fixed
assumptions.why: Brokers work office hours; overnight cases wait.

assumptions.label: Units reach the terminal up to this many hours before their original departure
assumptions.why: Arrivals spread from 6 h to 1 h before departure.

assumptions.label: Yard slots available for stranded units
assumptions.why: The rest of the yard is taken by regular traffic and imports.

assumptions.label: Booking must be confirmed this long before departure
assumptions.why: Load planning closes; later changes miss the stowage plan.

assumptions.label: Customer service agents 16:00–22:00
assumptions.why: Evening shift.

assumptions.label: Customer service agents 22:00–07:00
assumptions.why: Night desk.

assumptions.label: Customer service agents 07:00–16:00
assumptions.why: Day shift on a storm day, including people called in.

assumptions.label: Rebooking call: fixed handling time
assumptions.why: Identify the customer, explain the cancellation.

assumptions.label: Rebooking call: extra time per unit rebooked
assumptions.why: One booking screen per unit.

assumptions.label: Mean time a caller waits before hanging up
assumptions.why: Night callers are drivers and dispatchers with other work.

assumptions.label: Customers who call the same evening (AS-IS)
assumptions.why: The rest call when the office opens.

assumptions.label: Mean delay before a customer's first call
assumptions.why: Customers hear about it from the driver, the website or the terminal.

assumptions.label: Account managers start rebooking key accounts (minutes after Friday 00:00)
assumptions.why: 07:30 Friday; they are not on call at night.

assumptions.label: Account managers rebooking key accounts
assumptions.why: Two cover the contract customers.

assumptions.label: Account manager time per key account, fixed part
assumptions.why: Call the customer, agree the order, book.

assumptions.label: TO-BE: minutes from cancellation to a proposed recovery plan
assumptions.why: Unit list from the booking system plus allocation run.

assumptions.label: TO-BE: minutes the duty manager needs to review and approve
assumptions.why: Review classes, overrides, sign off.

assumptions.label: TO-BE: replan round interval
assumptions.why: Picks up customs releases and late changes.

assumptions.label: TO-BE: customers who still call after the message
assumptions.why: Questions about the new sailing, not rebooking.

assumptions.label: TO-BE: handling time of such a call
assumptions.why: The agent sees the plan and the reason per unit.

assumptions.label: TO-BE: units not yet at the terminal that hold at origin when asked
assumptions.why: Hauliers follow a concrete new slot; some are already on the road.

assumptions.label: Customers without a confirmed sailing after this many hours start sending units elsewhere
assumptions.why: Competing route or tunnel becomes the safer bet.

assumptions.label: Chance that such a unit is withdrawn
assumptions.why: Most customers wait; some cannot.

assumptions.label: Average commercial cost of a perishable unit that sails after its deadline
assumptions.why: Weather is force majeure, so most claims are rejected; this is the goodwill credit actually paid on average.

assumptions.label: Loaded cost of a customer service hour
assumptions.why: Salary, night premium and overhead.

assumptions.label: Contribution margin lost per withdrawn unit
assumptions.why: Single crossing; repeat business not counted.

assumptions.label: Disruption events per year with two or more cancelled sailings
assumptions.why: Winter storms plus strikes and technical failures. The riskiest assumption.

assumptions.label: One-off cost: two releases, integration, training
assumptions.why: Two quarters of a team of five plus supplier changes.

assumptions.label: Yearly run cost: licences, support, policy upkeep
assumptions.why: Includes one storm drill per year.

assumptions.label: Discount rate
assumptions.why: Finance standard for IT investments.

assumptions.label: Evaluation period
assumptions.why: Booking platform horizon.
